attchmntText: K S Oils Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the Un-Audited (Standalone) Financial results of 2nd quarter & half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: K.S. Oils Limited submitted extracts of its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE on November 14, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. The company published the extracts in Business Standard newspapers on November 14, 2026. Subam Papers Limited reported consolidated net profit after tax of negative 1914.59 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Palash Securities Limited reported standalone net profit after tax of 181.18 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Touchwood Entertainment Limited reported standalone net profit after tax of 754.1 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. La Opala RG Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Godawari Power and Ispat Limited reported consolidated net profit before tax of 229.20 crores for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: K S Oils Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  M/S Ernst & Young LLP. as Internal Auditor of the company for the Financial Year 2026-27.
voiceSummary: K.S. Oils Limited reported a loss of 7.54 crore for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and a loss of 13.30 crore for the half year ended 30 September 2026. Revenue from operations was 88.25 crore for the quarter and 250.34 crore for the half year. The Board of Directors approved the unaudited standalone financial results on 13 November 2026. Independent auditors NJG & Co. conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements. The company changed its depreciation method from Written Down Value to Straight Line Method effective 1 July 2026. This change reduced depreciation by 3.24 crore for the quarter and half year. The Kota plant commenced operations on 1 October 2025, and the Guna plant on 1 April 2026. Previous period figures are not comparable due to the company's acquisition by Soy-Sar Edible Private Limited. Paid-up equity share capital remains at 16.98 crore.
